sloka: यूयमेवाभिजानीत यो ऽयं यद्वा करिष्यति ।अहिरेव ह्यहेः पादान् विजानाति न संशयः ।। ५.४२.९।।।।
transliteration: yūyamevābhijānīta yo 'yaṁ yadvā kariṣyati ।ahireva hyaheḥ pādān vijānāti na saṁśayaḥ ।। 5.42.9।।।।

translations.english: "You alone can know about who he is and what he is about. A serpent alone knows the movement (footprints) of another serpent. There is no doubt about it.
